visible_text_labels: Animal procedures have been approved by the Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC) at Oakland University

Enucleation: 1. Ethically euthanize mouse according to IACUC standards. 2. Place the mouse on a sterile underpad. 3. Enucleate the eye by pressing 5/45 style tweezers on the orbital area to induce proptosis and then move tweezers to the eyes posterior to remove the eye (by gently pulling) while ensuring that the optical nerve is still intact.
